title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
hook_text: Twelve billion dollars lost in Intel.
script:
Twelve billion dollars just vanished from the government's Intel stake.
Intel stock crashed after the company missed critical quarterly earnings targets.
The company is suffering as PC sales continue to slide downward.
Meanwhile, the AI industry is aggressively gobbling up memory and other essential components.
This AI-driven demand is forcing component prices to rise significantly.
This leaves Intel exposed to massive market volatility as investors lose confidence.
Can the company stabilize its value before the government stake drops further?
